name: RugRadar AI
tagline: Scans a fresh Solana token's public chain record and lays out the rug-pull warning signs
description: Point it at a fresh Solana token and it reads the public chain record on the token and the wallet that deployed it. It lays out the familiar tells behind a rug pull, like concentrated holdings or rapid swap patterns, in a plain risk readout. Research only: no wallet connection, no signing, no nudge to buy.
author: teabagno1
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
